thing.text:
KEYS

The Scribe is handed
[keyboard, a pad].

Its thought is "some words
on the nest, and anything
beside them". A bare nest
matches nothing, and a robot
facing a bare nest dozes.

So "waiting for a key" is
not a feature. It is what
dozing already was.

TO RUN IT

Give the work box to the
Scribe.
It shrinks and waits.

Now type. Each key lands on
the keyboard nest, wakes it,
and is joined onto the pad --
so the pad says what you
typed.

A printable key arrives as
itself -- including the
space. The rest arrive as
words: Enter, ArrowLeft.

THE DEVICE ITSELF

The nest in hole 1 is one of
the workshop's senses. There
is nothing to connect: it
wears the keyboard's name, so
the keyboard delivers to it.

Take another out of the
Devices notebook (the menu)
and it joins the same flock --
two robots can watch the one
keyboard.

It has no egg, so no bird can
be had from it: nothing you
build can write to a device.
